messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT 1719991234 - node tmpfs spike -> multiple serve pods evicted on gpu-pool-us-east-2. Paging oncall: @kai (oncall) :rotating_light:

kai (oncall): I'm on it. seeing alerts for 3 pods in CrashLoopBackOff + eviction events. any customer-facing 5xxs?

Evan (cs): One customer (retail-ml) reported intermittent timeouts 10m ago, said several requests failed with 502. They posted a stack trace.

Jordan (sre): grabbing logs + node metrics. prelim: /var/tmp usage at 98% on node-13, journalctl shows heavy modelcache writes. Kernel evicted pods due to ephemeral storage pressure.

Priya (eng-runtime): ugh modelcache wrote checkpoints to /tmp/modelcache/checkpoints. We had a fallback disabled for pruning.

Marta (eng-platform): any chance logrotate misconfig? last deploy modified logging level to DEBUG for modelcache.

kai (oncall): OK timeline: pods started thrashing ~10:42 UTC, first eviction at 10:44. Customers started reporting 10:45.

Jordan (sre): attaching quick snippets:

```
$ kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide | grep modelcache
modelcache-7df9c   0/1   Evicted   0     10m   node-13
serve-a3b1         0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   3  9m    node-13
serve-bc22         1/1   Running           0  1h    node-14
```

```
$ kubectl describe pod modelcache-7df9c -n redwood-serving
Reason: Evicted
Message: Pod triggered evicted due to node(s) running out of ephemeral storage
```

And node df -h: `/dev/shm` and `/tmp` ~ 98%.

Priya (eng-runtime): share a tail of the runtime logs from serve-a3b1:

```
I2026-02-27T10:43:57Z runtime: filling model cache /var/tmp/modelcache shard-0
E2026-02-27T10:44:01Z runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 1.2G for KV cache
E2026-02-27T10:44:02Z runtime: process terminated by SIGABRT
```

kai (oncall): Looks like two contributors: modelcache writing large checkpoints to tmp, and runtime getting CUDA OOM (likely due to degraded swap after eviction?). Need to stabilize.

Marta (eng-platform): immediate mitigations: 1) cordon node-13, 2) drain non-critical pods, 3) clean /var/tmp/modelcache on node if safe. Any objections?

Priya (eng-runtime): +1 to cordon/drain. For modelcache we can disable checkpointing via env var MODEL_CACHE_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL=0 and restart. That should stop immediate writes.

Jordan (sre): I'll run cordon + drain for node-13 now. planning: `kubectl cordon node-13` -> `kubectl drain node-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30` to move running workloads.

ops-bot: deploy queued: lockdown-cleanup-script v2 by @Jordan will run once approvals granted.

kai (oncall): Jordan, please only delete emptyDir contents for modelcache dirs after confirming it's safe to lose in-flight cache. Priya, what's the impact of removing /var/tmp/modelcache contents?

Priya (eng-runtime): We'll lose warmed model shards; cold-start will add ~200ms/predict for first few requests. That's acceptable vs continued evictions. Confirm safe to delete.

Jordan (sre): I'm running a low-risk cleanup on node-13: `ssh node-13 -- sudo rm -rf /var/tmp/modelcache/checkpoints/*` starting now.

Jordan (sre): cleanup complete. freed ~48GB. df now shows /tmp 34% used.

deploy-bot: restart initiated for deployment/serve-a3b1 in redwood-serving namespace (rolling restart).

Priya (eng-runtime): restarting runtime with MODEL_CACHE_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL=0 and lower logging: LOG_LEVEL=info. Also set RUNTIME_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=20G.

kai (oncall): Good. Monitoring evictions and pod stability. Any sign of new evictions?

Jordan (sre): No new evictions in last 3m. serve-a3b1 restarted and passed readiness probe. serve-bc22 still healthy. modelcache pods recreated and are now Running.

Evan (cs): Retail-ml confirmed degraded window between 10:45-10:55, ~12% request failures. They've resumed normal traffic and asked for a summary.

Marta (eng-platform): root cause hypothesis: DEBUG logging + checkpointing led to runaway writes to tmpfs combined with an autoscaler burst placing extra modelcache shards on node-13. We'll need policy changes: prefer PV-backed storage for modelcache checkpoints and guardrails to prevent heavy writes to ephemeral.

Priya (eng-runtime): Agreed. Postmortem actions: 1) make checkpoints PV-only (config flag), 2) add a runtime limiter for checkpoint size + rate, 3) revert DEBUG logging changes, 4) add node-level ephemeral storage alert earlier.

kai (oncall): I'm handing off to Jordan for the rest of the mitigation window and post-incident follow-ups. I'll update incident log and notify CS. @Jordan you're on shift until 15:00 UTC?

Jordan (sre): Affirmative, I'll own the postmortem draft and coordinate with Priya and Marta.

Evan (cs): I'll send a customer-facing timeline to retail-ml and copy the postmortem once ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident 1719991234 status -> mitigated. Pager cleared at 10:57 UTC. Follow-up: create INC-171999 action item for PV migration and logging revert.

Priya (eng-runtime): quick note: we'll prepare a canary change to disable checkpoints by default and limit per-shard disk usage. Will post PR shortly.

Marta (eng-platform): I'll add a node pressure alert threshold to trigger at 75% ephemeral usage and a runbook step to check modelcache config.

kai (oncall): Closing handoff. Thanks everyone. we'll reconvene for postmortem at 15:30 UTC.

Jordan (sre): leaving final log snippets and commands used in the incident channel gist: https://internal.gists/rw/1719991234-cleanup

ops-bot: reminder created: INC-171999 -> assignees: Priya, Marta, Jordan. due: 2026-03-05

Evan (cs): Customer update sent. No active impact now.

sre-bot: THREAD CLOSED (mitigation complete).
